title: MindMap: Knowledge Graph Prompting for LLM Reasoning
summary: This community centers on the 2024 paper 'MindMap: Knowledge Graph Prompting Sparks Graph of Thoughts in Large Language Models.' The work is authored by Yilin Wen, Zifeng Wang, and Jimeng Sun, and was published on arXiv. It represents a specific contribution to the field of combining knowledge graphs with large language model prompting strategies.
key_findings: The paper 'MindMap' was published in 2024 on arXiv under the identifier 2308.09729.
Yilin Wen is listed as an author of the MindMap paper.
